run_pip_init_cli: run the pip initializer CLI to install versioned pip packages for linter setup
run_run_command: run a subprocess command with timing and debug logging via run_command
install_linter_packages: install linter packages with pinned versions using pip3 install in user or venv mode
dry_run_pip_init: preview pip install commands without executing by passing --dry-run 1 to the CLI
validate_package_versions: validate that all pip packages have explicit versions specified before installation
